name: The Duchess Affair
source:
Your marriage to a wealthy duke saved your family from ruin...But when a new tutor expands your erotic studies, will you risk everything for love?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Duchess_Affair]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你与一位富有的公爵的婚姻使你的家庭免于破产……但是当一位新导师扩大你的色情研究时，你会为了爱情冒一切风险吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Duchess_Affair]Choices Wikia[/url]]
